Navigation, Cooled Seats, Leather Seats, 360 Camera, Harman/Kardon Audio!

The 2026 Subaru Forester features advanced safety and driver-assist technologies engineered to support your journey with assurance.

From the outside, the 2026 Subaru Forester showcases a robust stance, refined bodywork and upscale lighting that highlight its purposeful SUV persona. Inside, the cabin features quality materials, intuitive connectivity and seating designed for comfort, whether you're driving or riding along. With its enduring all-wheel-drive system, smart features and Subarus reputation for dependability, the Forester offers a well-rounded driving experience for both everyday life and adventure.

This Autumn Green Metallic SUV has an Automatic transmission and is powered by a 180HP 2.5L 4 Cylinder Engine.

Our Forester's trim level is Premier. The interior combines luxury, technology, and all-weather comfort, offering heated leather seats with driver memory, a 10-way power-adjustable drivers seat, and dual-zone automatic climate control for a refined driving experience in any season. A heated leather steering wheel, soft-touch materials, and simulated suede accents enhance the upscale cabin feel, while the panoramic sunroof floods the interior with natural light. The 11.6-inch tablet-style infotainment system with GPS navigation seamlessly integrates wireless Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, SiriusXM, and Bluetooth, powered by an 11-speaker Harman Kardon audio system with subwoofer and amplifier for premium sound quality. Safety and driver assistance are anchored by Subarus EyeSight technology suite, featuring adaptive cruise control, lane centering, pre-collision braking, blind spot detection, reverse automatic braking, and Evasion Assist for added confidence on every journey. This vehicle has been upgraded with the following features: Navigation, Cooled Seats, Leather Seats, 360 Camera, Harman/Kardon Audio, Panoramic Sunroof, Power Liftgate. This is a demonstrator vehicle driven by a member of our staff and has just 8649 km.
